behavior: The pay page shows a receipt after settlement, and the pay page and dashboard link to both PDFs
acceptance: R-48: /pay/<id> links to the invoice PDF at any time; after settlement it shows amount, paid and settled times, deposit and settlement tx hashes with explorer links and the receipt PDF link; before settlement no receipt shows; the dashboard invoice detail links to both PDFs (the receipt once paid)
R-48: Playwright covers the page before and after settlement; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: PASS after two fixes. paidAt/settledAt read in the single invoice query, settledAt from the unique settlement ledger entry booked in the same transaction as settled; no private data leaked; explorer links per chain via txLink; dashboard receipt link gated on paid like the API's 409; pay page has no Privy or new scripts, same-origin PDF links, axe 0 serious/critical on settled in both themes. FIXED: the receipt PDF listed late deposits held for the payer (D-26), now only confirmed non-late ones, TestReceiptPDF adds a late deposit (fails without the fix); a paid or settled pay page no longer shows the checkout countdown (e2e asserts it). Re-verified 8 checks.
